fields.summary_ko.0: Samsung Electronics Q3 results: revenue of KRW 195.3 trillion (+126.9% year-over-year), operating profit of KRW 107.4 trillion (+783.1%), operating margin of 55.0%, achieving record high for fourth consecutive quarter
fields.summary_ko.1: Securities firms' price targets range from KRW 270,000 (BNK Securities) to KRW 670,000 (Nomura Securities), with divergence mainly due to differing expectations regarding speed of high-value AI memory (HBM4) adoption
fields.summary_ko.2: Sustainability of memory supply shortage, HBM4 yield improvement, share repurchase capacity, foreign exchange rates, and foreign investor demand are key variables determining H2 stock price performance
